newsitem.title: INDIA: RBI relaxes expatriate Indian share purchase norms.
newsitem.headline: RBI relaxes expatriate Indian share purchase norms.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Wednesday it has relaxed procedures on share purchases by expatriate Indians.
"Indian companies will no longer have to approach the RBI twice for seeking permission for issue and export of shares to non-resident Indian investors (NRIs)," the central bank said in a statement.
Companies will now have to obtain "one-stage" RBI approval for selling stock to NRIs showing documentary evidence of inward remittance of funds, the RBI said.
